accident_report: V1 (Sports car) is initially in Lane 1 traveling at 65 mph, behind V2 (Truck) which is in Lane 2 at 55 mph. V3 (SUV) is ahead of V2 in Lane 2, also at 55 mph, and V4 (Sedan) is in Lane 3 at 65 mph. V1 changes from Lane 1 to Lane 2 to overtake V2. After overtaking V2, V1 needs to enter Lane 3 to fully overtake V3. However, due to an unidentified critical pre-crash event, V1 acts erratically while overtaking V3. Seeing V4 in Lane 3 traveling at 65 mph, V1 attempts to merge back into Lane 2 and then Lane 1. During this maneuver, V1 sideswipes V2 in Lane 2 due to the speed differential. The result is a sideswipe collision between V1 and V2 in Lane 2, causing damage to both vehicles.
